translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

content: ATuhsipsip mai nǝvanuan san gail
Beti nokǝta, noris aTuhsipsip toil len Naṽehuh Sion. Ikad nǝvanuan lotovi 144,000 lototah maii. Len natosian len nabunǝholito lukad nahǝsan mai nahǝsan aTǝman.
Ale nosǝsǝloŋ hǝn nǝwalan togǝm len nǝmav, tohum nǝtas kudkud topus mai nab̃iliurur tokurut habat. Ehum nǝwalan nǝvanuan lotogole nǝboŋ lotoram̃ram̃e b̃onb̃on hǝn navus beltaŋ tosob̃ur.

Alat lotovi 144,000 lokǝkai hǝn nǝb̃e veveu a m̃o len nab̃iltihai bǝtbǝtah, mai len nǝhon natit tovat lotomaur, mai nǝvanuan totibau lotovi 24. Sǝkad avan ideh tolǝboi lǝb̃ekǝkai sǝhot nǝb̃e enan, be alat lotovi 144,000 aGot toṽur galit dan nǝvanuan p̃isi len navile a pan, galit ŋai lokǝkai sǝhoti.

Lotǝgau gat naveveuan salito, lǝsǝbar niben apǝhaṽut ideh, be lohushusur aTuhsipsip len naut ideh tovi lan. Galit lovi alat aGot toṽur galit dan nǝvanuan gail p̃isi hǝn lǝb̃evi esan mai seTuhsipsip. Lohum naṽit metǝkav hǝn nǝmatuan tovi naviolan vi tǝban aGot.
Nalibliboŋan sagǝm len nabuŋolit boŋ ideh, sǝkad natideh tosa len galito avan ideh tolǝboi b̃ikel uri.
Aŋel itor

Beti noris aŋel togon tomǝlah len namǝsav. Ikad na-kel-uri-an tovoi topat vi sutuai hǝn b̃ikel uri mai alat lotosuh len navile a pan: naluṽoh hǝn nǝvanuan naut tiltile p̃isi, nǝvanuan len nahǝmar p̃isi, nasoruan p̃isi mai nabi tiltile gail p̃isi.
Ale ikai habat ke, “Mǝtemǝtahw len aGot! Sal suh nǝyalyalan san, bathut namityal hǝn b̃epǝpehun navoian dan nǝsaan egǝm pǝpadaŋ. Mitilotu hǝn atenan togol nǝmav, nǝtan, nǝtas mai nabǝko gail p̃isi.”
Ale aŋel na-vǝha-ru-an ehusur aŋel metǝkav, ike, “Imasig! Naut a Papilon toyalyal imasirsir! Igol nǝvanuan naut tiltile p̃isi lotǝrog hǝn nǝwain han tovi nab̃iltilǝŋonian san hǝn naitian tosa.”
Ale aŋel na-vǝha-tor-an ehusur gǝlaru, ikai habat ke, “Avan ideh tolotu hǝn narivatǝvat katkat mai nǝlablab han, tokad nǝmak san len nabunǝhon o navǝlan,

dereh gai temun nǝwain hǝn nab̃iltilol paŋpaŋ siGot, nǝwain aGot tob̃ir masmas hǝni vi lan nab̃iliwai hǝn nǝlol paŋpaŋ san. Ale avan enan dereh telǝŋon tisa vǝsa habat len nǝhab mai nǝsalfa len nǝhon aŋel siGot gail mai aTuhsipsip.

Nǝbasuhab hǝn na-lǝŋon-isa-vǝsa-an silat lotomaienan dereh tikon vi mǝhat vi sutuai vi sutuai. Asike lukad nǝŋavŋavan len nalennǝyal o nalenmariug husur lotolotu hǝn narivatǝvat katkat mai nǝlablab han, ale lukad nǝmak hǝn nahǝsan.”
Imagenan, nǝvanuan siGot gail, alat lotogol nǝsa tokele, lotodaŋ len aYesu, limaskad nǝ-daŋ-b̃uri-an.

Beti nosǝsǝloŋ hǝn nadoldol len nǝmav toke, “Gitos gat nategai ke: Gagai van, alat lotomat len Nasub̃, navoian siGot igol lukab hǝni.” ANunun aGot ike, “Evoi, lukab habat hǝni husur dereh liŋavŋav dan nǝmauran salit todaŋ, bathut dereh likad naṽit nagolean salit lotovoi.”
Nǝmatuan hǝn navile a pan
Beti noris nǝmavukasw sua, ale ikad avan sua tobǝtah len nǝmavukasw tosum̃an anatun nǝvanuan.
Ikad nǝkraun hǝn nagol len nǝkadun, ale len navǝlan etǝgau nab̃u tohab̃ tokan len nǝlon.
Beti aŋel togon evivile len naim siGot. Ikai van hǝn atenan tobǝtah len nǝmavukasw, ike, “Gilav nab̃u sam̃ tohab̃, tub̃at tai nǝhanian. Nǝhanian len navile a pan imatu, evi namityal hǝn nǝmatuan!”
Ŋa atenan tobǝtah len nǝmavukasw ita kokotov nǝhanian tomatu len navile a pan kavkav, ale isah tuani.
Beti aŋel sual am evivile len naim siGot len nǝmav. Gai am etǝgau nab̃u tohab̃ tokan.

Ale aŋel tile am tokad nǝdaŋan hǝn towol hǝn nǝhab, egǝm len nǝmel tutumavan. Ikai habat van hǝn aŋel tokad nab̃u tohab̃, ike, “Gilav nab̃u sam̃ tohab̃, tub̃at ta kokotov nǝhavhǝt nakrep len navile a pan, sah tuan gail. Len nǝhau nakrep gail naṽit nakrep lumen.”
Ŋa aŋel ita kokotov nǝhavhǝt nakrep gail len navile a pan, ale ebubulan nǝhavhǝt nakrep gail len nab̃iltib̃ur lotopal dasdas naṽit nakrep lan. Evi nab̃iltib̃ur hǝn nǝlol paŋpaŋ siGot.
Ale lupal dasdas nakrep gail len nab̃iltib̃ur vivile len nab̃iltivile. Ale nǝda eriv dan nab̃iltib̃ur enan, epul vǝbar nǝkadun nahos gail ale isel, nabǝlavan han evi nǝstatia tovi 1,600.

footnotes.text: 14.12 Egai nǝbathusoruan hǝn nalob̃ulat egai. Datimasgol husur nǝsa aGot tokele, datimasdaŋ len aYesu, datimassusumar, datimasdaŋ b̃ur nǝmauran sidat todaŋ, naut kǝmas datb̃imat sil nadǝlomian dattokade len aYesu.
14.14 Dan 7.13. Vǝha-sob̃sob̃ur aYesu ekis gai gabag aNatun Nǝvanuan.
14.20 Hǝn naves 19-20, ris Isa 63.1-6; Lam 1.15. Nabǝlavan hǝn nǝstatia evi namita tovi 185.
